question: With code execution enabled, do both adapters surface the executable code and its execution result, and in what part shape?

textParts: To compute the 12th Fibonacci number, I used the following Python code. This implementation defines the Fibonacci sequence starting with $F(0)=0$ and $F(1)=1$.

finding: @google/genai emitted part sequence [executableCode,codeExecutionResult,text] with executableCode (PYTHON, 352 chars) and codeExecutionResult (OUTCOME_OK, 34 chars of output); the AI SDK emitted [tool-call,tool-result,text] with tool-call "code_execution" (providerExecuted: true) and a tool-result carrying the output. The executableCode -> CodeBlock and codeExecutionResult -> tool-response convention in neutralConverters is written against @google/genai Part shapes, so on the AI SDK path an adapter re-targets it at tool-call/tool-result parts and parses the JSON-string input. The payloads themselves are equivalent, and the SDK already stamps the code_execution name and the providerExecuted flag.
